text: On the 80th Independence Day of Pakistan, we celebrate the spirit of Freedom, Unity and Resilience that continues to define our Nation. On this day, we honour the sacrifices of those who made our freedom possible and renew our commitment to Pakistan’s progress, prosperity, unity

text: On 14 August 1947, a nation was born from struggle, sacrifice and an unbreakable will to stand on its own feet. Seventy-nine years later, that same spirit lives on—not only in our history, but on the hockey turf, the cricket pitch, the squash court and the athletics track.
